goal: Replace the complete selection catalogue with all 82 authored entries

authorizedPilot.scope: local staged catalogue only, separate launcher and shared budget

evidence: decoded media and verified font bytes
authenticated save and reopen with official adapter

rules: Work each entry independently; previous family names do not restrict the new collection.
HTML/CSS/SVG is source geometry; translate to native layers and verified decorative assets without flattening editable text.
Freeze a 1080x1350 artboard, fonts and animation frame before evaluating visual fidelity.
Topic labels and example copy are not exclusive use restrictions or factual evidence.
Validate content bindings before promising roles such as cover, development, list or closing.
A technical pass is not visual approval; a missing renderer feature is an adaptation task rather than automatic rejection.
Record the reason and next action for every unresolved entry; do not silently remove it from the roster.
Preparatory receipt validation checks coverage and shape only; it cannot publish or authenticate review evidence.
The previous catalogue is recovery evidence and saved-document compatibility material, never a fallback source for new selections.
Do not convert capability counts to ranking bonuses. The local fit checks exact needs; JEV receives a single profile of each recovered family.
New requests pin the family identity tie seed, policy, profile, and index. Historical receipts are read with their own policy.
Keep the original authorized upload when the current request explicitly asks to preserve it; no image generation call for that slot.
Plan carousel closing separately from development items; treat an explicit page count as a layout requirement.
The staged local override contains only verified families and roles in selection; archived rows are retained for history.
